name: rooks-beta
description: Build online forms, surveys, and intake forms on Rooks by describing them, with conditional logic, file uploads, and signatures. Get Rooks form-building guidance, and use the Rooks MCP connection to create, edit, preview, and publish forms. Rooks hosts the forms and collects the responses.
